transparent.title: Transparent. Open. Accountable.
transparent.body: This tool is built by Jordan Open Source Association (JOSA), open-source, and audited. See exactly how it works. See the reasoning behind every finding.

deepAnalysis.title: Deep Technical Analysis
deepAnalysis.body: We analyze the APK's permissions, code, and network behavior. Cross-check against threat databases. Flag obfuscation, suspicious libraries, and known malware signatures. You get the technical details if you want them, or just the plain-language verdict.

report.title: Downloadable Sharable Report
report.body: Export results in a format you can safely share with colleagues. Works offline. Nothing stored in the cloud after you leave.

aboutView.title: About Fukhara
aboutView.intro: Fukhara checks Android apps and tells you whether they look dangerous. It is built and run by Jordan Open Source Association, in the open.

who.orgDescription: JOSA is the not-for-profit organisation that works for a better Jordan through openness in technology.
who.body: JOSA builds Fukhara, runs it, and answers for it. If a result looks wrong, or you want to know who has access to what, you can reach the people responsible.

why.p1: An Android app is just a file, and anyone can send you one. Apps shared through chats, email or websites don't pass through a store's checks, and you can't tell a safe one from a dangerous one by looking at it.
why.p2: Fukhara gives you a clear answer. Upload the file and we tell you whether it looks dangerous and why: plain language first, technical detail if you want it.
